scripts.text:
[Elven Ears Quest]
Hi, today's quest is....
Ah, the ^61B031Elven Ears ^000000Quest!
scripts.translation:
[精靈之耳任務]
你好，今天的任務是...
啊，是^61B031妖精長耳朵飾 ^000000任務！

scripts.text:
[Elven Ears quest]
Good good, let me just check
scripts.translation:
[精靈之耳任務]
好的好的，讓我先確認一下

scripts.text:
[Elven Ears quest]
Give me a second.....

scripts.translation:
[精靈之耳任務]
好了，完成了！

scripts.text:
[Elven Ears Quest]
You don't have the requirements.
Please come back another time...
scripts.translation:
[精靈之耳任務]
您不滿足任務要求。
請改天再來吧...

scripts.text:
[Elven Ears Quest]
Ok all you have to do is collect:
^362ED61 Kitty Band^000000
^362ED620 Elder Pixie Mustaches^000000
and ^362ED620 Animal Skin^000000
scripts.translation:
[精靈之耳任務]
只需要收集這些材料：
^362ED61個貓耳髮圈^000000
^362ED620個老妖精鬍鬚^000000
以及^362ED620張動物外皮^000000

scripts.text:
[Elven Ears Quest]
When you are done, bring the items to me.  Ok good luck finding those items.
scripts.translation:
[精靈之耳任務]
收集完成後，把物品交給我。好的，祝您收集順利。

[精靈之耳任務]
也許改天再來？

scripts.text:
[Elven Ears quest]
Aw, what a shame
Giving up already?
Oh well maybe you will participate in tomorrow's quest.
scripts.translation:
[精靈之耳任務]
哎呀，真可惜
這就放棄了嗎？
好吧，也許您會參加明天的任務。
